name: JMS Website
overview: This site. React + TypeScript front end, Express + SQLite API, Nginx reverse proxy, all containerized with Docker. Hosts a hero/CV landing page, a paginated projects page with tag filters, and per-project threaded comments behind sign-in.
contributions: Sole author. Built the full stack, wrote the Docker and Nginx setup, and authored the projects-page refactor that introduced pagination and tag filters.
documentation: See the README in the repo for stack details, repository layout, and local-development instructions.

name: Gaming-IMBD-Documentation
overview: Team Fike's UMaine Computer Science capstone project: a documentation-only repository preserving the planning, design, and process artifacts for a video-game preservation system. The implementation code held Activision IP and remained private, so only the design documents are public.
contributions: Contributed to the team's design artifacts alongside other Team Fike members — critical design review, system requirements specification, and software design document.
documentation: See the README in the repo for links to the Critical Design Review, System Requirements Specification, and Software Design Document.

name: DigitalForestKG_UX
overview: Scripts and UI for the Digital Forest Knowledge Graph project — a research effort under the SKAI Lab to model forest-related data as a queryable knowledge graph. This fork carries the UX-focused work; the upstream lives at theSKAILab/DigitalForestKG.
contributions: Team contributor. Worked on the front-end UI and the data-loading scripts that feed the graph. The project was led by daniel-lawrence under the SKAI Lab.
documentation: See the README in this fork; Our work is accessible with FLASK_TEMPLATES=templates_dev.

name: LessonAgent
overview: AssignmentAlly: a web app that helps students design augmented coursework assignments connected to career goals, then format them into a formal proposal for a professor to approve.
contributions: Co-author on a small team. Contributed to the agent flow, the UI, and the Docker setup.
documentation: See the README in the repo for setup, prerequisites, project structure, and a walkthrough for running the app locally.

name: Franco-Code
overview: Web scraping and sanitization toolchain for the Franco-American Bibliography project. Migrates published-work records from francolibrary.com to francolibrary.org, normalizes the data, and handles geolocation lookups.
contributions: Sole author. Built the scrapers, the sanitization pipeline, and the Jupyter notebooks used to validate the migrated data.
documentation: See the README in the repo for a file-by-file breakdown of the pipeline. The live destination of the migrated data is francolibrary.org.

name: COS_498_598_Project_GROUP_3
overview: UMaine COS 498/598 NLP course project (Group 3): augments natural-language sentences with semantically appropriate emojis by comparing sentence-transformer embeddings against per-emoji centroid vectors.
contributions: Group 3 team member. Contributed to the embedding pipeline and the centroid-matching logic.
documentation: MinimizingLanguageWithEmojis_Group3.pdf is a research report on the project. See the README in the repo for environment setup, GPU acceleration notes, the spaCy model dependency, and the pipeline execution steps.

name: WebserverFinal
overview: Wild West Forum: a server-side web-development final project. Full-stack themed forum with threaded posts, user accounts, and a SQLite store. The repo also contains the midterm and final video demos.
contributions: Sole author. Designed the schema, built the Handlebars-rendered views and the Express routes, and recorded the demo videos.
documentation: See the README in the repo for project metadata and setup; the bundled video demos walk through the feature set.
